name: live-v15b-an-background-ledger
objective: v2.3 replan V15b on a real SillyTavern (no model needed: the writes under test are host effects): a checkpoint's Author's Note and background go through the effect ledger — a row records what each replaced BEFORE the host is touched, the host really holds the new values — and restarting the story puts both back from the rows' `before` values: the note returns to the text it replaced (a clear would leave it empty) and the background to the one it replaced. A restart empties the ledger, so the rows themselves are not readable afterwards. The background baseline is recorded first and restored at the end whatever happens, because a background is install state.

steps.eval: const bg = document.querySelector('#bg1')?.style?.backgroundImage ?? ''; const settings = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata?.custom_background ?? null; globalThis.__v15bBaseline = { settingsName: (await import('/scripts/backgrounds.js')).background_settings?.name ?? '', locked: settings, note: document.querySelector('#extension_floating_prompt')?.value ?? '' }; if (globalThis.__v15bBaseline.settingsName.toLowerCase() === 'bedroom red.jpg') throw new Error('the baseline background is already the one this check switches to, so the switch would prove nothing'); return globalThis.__v15bBaseline;

import_story.title: SO-V15b Ledger
import_story.description: A second checkpoint that sets an Author's Note and a background.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await rt.activateCheckpoint('hall'); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500)); const ledger = rt.getSnapshot().effects.ledger; const note = ledger.find((row) => row.effect === 'author_note'); const bg = ledger.find((row) => row.effect === 'background'); if (!note || !bg) throw new Error(`the note and the background must each have a ledger row: ${JSON.stringify(ledger.map((row) => row.effect))}`); if (note.status !== 'applied' || bg.status !== 'applied') throw new Error(`rows not applied: ${JSON.stringify([note, bg])}`); if (note.target.kind !== 'an' || note.after?.text !== 'SO-V15b note: speak in whispers.') throw new Error(`note row: ${JSON.stringify(note)}`); if (bg.after?.name !== 'bedroom red.jpg' || (bg.before?.name ?? '') !== globalThis.__v15bBaseline.settingsName) throw new Error(`the background row must record what it replaced: ${JSON.stringify(bg)} vs baseline ${globalThis.__v15bBaseline.settingsName}`); const field = document.querySelector('#extension_floating_prompt')?.value ?? ''; const current = (await import('/scripts/backgrounds.js')).background_settings?.name ?? ''; if (field !== 'SO-V15b note: speak in whispers.') throw new Error(`the host does not hold the note: ${JSON.stringify(field)}`); if (current !== 'bedroom red.jpg') throw new Error(`the host did not switch the background: ${current}`); return { note: { before: note.before, after: note.after }, background: { before: bg.before, after: bg.after }, field, current };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await rt.restartStory(true); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000)); const ledger = rt.getSnapshot().effects.ledger; const statuses = ledger.map((row) => `${row.effect}:${row.status}`); const field = document.querySelector('#extension_floating_prompt')?.value ?? ''; const current = (await import('/scripts/backgrounds.js')).background_settings?.name ?? ''; return { statuses, field, current, baseline: globalThis.__v15bBaseline };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const field = document.querySelector('#extension_floating_prompt')?.value ?? ''; const current = (await import('/scripts/backgrounds.js')).background_settings?.name ?? ''; const baseline = globalThis.__v15bBaseline; const problems = []; if (field !== baseline.note) problems.push(`note is ${JSON.stringify(field)}, was ${JSON.stringify(baseline.note)}`); if (current !== baseline.settingsName) problems.push(`background is ${current}, was ${baseline.settingsName}`); if (problems.length) { if (current !== baseline.settingsName && baseline.settingsName) await SillyTavern.getContext().executeSlashCommandsWithOptions(`/bg ${baseline.settingsName}`); throw new Error(`restart did not put the host back: ${problems.join('; ')}`); } return { restored: true };
